Text:
[II] God our Father, You have risen Jesus Christ from death, and have exalted Him to Your right hand. Hear us as we pray to You:
[IR] Lord, keep Your people safe within the glory of Christ.
[I1] Righteous Father, You raised Jesus from the depths of earth through the victory of the cross;
[I2] may all things be drawn to Him.
[I1] Through the Son You exalted, You send the Holy Spirit into Your Church,
[I2] that Your Church may be the sacrament of unity for all people.
[I1] Through water and the Holy Spirit, You gave birth to a new people:
[I2] give each person the faith to walk from baptism to eternal life.
[I1] By the glory of Your Son, bless the poor, free the prisoner, and heal the sick,
[I2] so that, in Your blessings, creation will know joy.
[I1] May our deceased siblings, whom You offered the Body and Blood of the glorious Christ,
[I2] on the final day, be a part of the resurrection.
